scope: M2-B continuous account and learning branches, including final captured-intervention and membership-input checks

targeted.command: uv run pytest tests/test_walk_branch.py tests/test_walk_forward.py tests/test_review.py tests/test_decision_frames.py tests/test_decision_lab.py tests/test_trader_lifecycle_m1.py tests/test_t1_decider.py -q --no-header

full_suite.warning_detail: Existing test_build_lock multi-threaded multiprocessing fork deprecation warnings

source_verification.method: Verified all nine entries from tested-files.tar.gz against verified-files.json using SHA-256 and Git blob SHA; compared with the successful M2-B core archive
source_verification.documentation: Completed follow-up note and this verification record are added after testing; original core verification is retained

initial_final_review.finding: New evidence reader used a plural provenance key; corrected to the existing singular intervention contract without weakening the regression assertion

evidence_limits: Continuity uses synthetic market fixtures through the real runner
Independent next-day learning is tested with deterministic stub model responses, not real-model learning quality
An applied input is a verified captured frame, not proof the model followed the instruction
Treatment changes only the first eligible open plan on the first branch day; not permanent rule removal
Historical prefix evidence remains inherited and is not counted as a fresh experimental observation
Hashes establish content identity, not point-in-time market truth or provider authenticity
Original user seven-run journals and historical corpus were not rerun
No profitability, drawdown improvement, full online/replay convergence, scheduler isolation or M3 promotion claim
